content:
Today, Apple TV released the trailer for the fifth season of the award-winning children's mindfulness programme 《Stillwater》. Watch it below.

《Stillwater》will return on August 21.

A few days ago, Apple TV confirmed the premiere date for the fifth season of 《Stillwater》, with five episodes dropping simultaneously on August 21.

According to Apple TV, the new season of 《Stillwater》will incorporate more "breathing exercises, mindfulness moments, and simple everyday habits", continuing the show's mission of helping children and their families find inner calm.

《Stillwater》originally premiered on Apple TV in 2020, and has since won a Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Editing in a Preschool Animated Programme, as well as a Peabody Award in the Children/Youth category.

Below is Apple TV's introduction to the basic story background of 《Stillwater》. The programme is adapted from Jon J Muth's bestselling 《Zen》 picture book series published by Scholastic:
